review_history: Initial experimental Virtualization VNC mode listened on a host wildcard address, despite printing a loopback URL. The VM was stopped and restarted without that mode.
Current route will use guest Screen Sharing over host-only networking; an RFB handshake is not screenshot/input acceptance.
Imported CI image reports guest Gatekeeper assessments disabled. Guest provisioning/hardening and bridge acceptance are delegated to Kimi; no host security setting was changed.
ownership_note: VM bootstrap preceded the user clarification that all further operational execution must be delegated to Kimi. That clarification now governs the project.
limitations: Guest boot/desktop only; no accepted robotic input, video-to-policy loop, or trained policy
No robot real-time stream accepted at this point
Guest-only automated input/capture, cursor visibility and stop/timeout behavior remain to be verified
